verdict.rationale: Zep automatically generates AI-derived artifacts from ingested data — thread summaries (zep-docs-8) and a Context Graph with extracted entities/relations/facts (zep-docs-27, zep-gh-1) — which function as data-derived insights, and its search/context composition (zep-docs-9, zep-docs-10) surfaces relevant information dynamically. However, there is no evidence of proactive 'suggestions' (e.g., recommended actions, anomaly alerts, or generated recommendations) beyond summarization and retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit suggestion/recommendation generation, evidence of insight surfacing in a UI/dashboard, and independent validation of insight quality beyond docs.
